'''Pentix Graphyt''', also known as '''Special Operative 1312''', was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] allied with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. A large man, he wore a suit of armor including a mirrored helmet that hid his identity.<ref name="OOAK" />

[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Gaevril Daraada]] dispatched Graphyt to stop the New Republic operative [[Shandria L'hnnar]] and the [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Sienn Sconn]] from escaping from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Venaari]]. Sconn fought Graphyt on top of a stolen [[SV-50 Swift-Strike Speeder]]. Initially, Graphyt had the upper hand using his strength and size against Sconn. However, Sconn punctured the coolant tanks of Graphyt's [[Rocket pack/Legends|rocket pack]], strapped several [[thermal half-sphere]]s to the bounty hunter, then used him as a makeshift missile to destroy an Imperial blockade of the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="OOAK" />
